note: Item 3 a: the commit c6d64f97 on main 262b9a68 passed tests, path and gate, but its 2997 at the final tier shows a new fault (bricks and flecks where the wide level now draws and the picture moves), so it is not named; cause and cure are being tested. M8: the limb edge measured. Item 3 b: test 2 with a gate.

looks.label: The same without the gate, for comparison: the stipple of dabs on the flat ground above.

Item 3 b, test 2 with a gate: the finish of the repainted centre carried by example to the ring, only where the wrap itself has forms. One to one on the plane of the patch, left the wrap, right with the finish; above flat cream ground, below curls. The stipple on flat ground is nearly gone, the curls keep their crisp edges.

M8, why: the hold 2895 above, the rise 3296 below, both final tier, half size. The wide glow outside the lit limb of the hold lies in the hold's sky patch (the approved picture's own sky); the rise has only the globe's own skirt, which ends 0.03 radii beyond the limb.

M8, the lit limb at 3296 ten times enlarged: one sample beside the final tier. The edge of the disc is smooth (its crossing of level 160 lies within 0.06 px of a smooth curve, row to row 0.03 px), but it is harder than the hold's: largest step of one pixel 43 of a rise of 200, the hold 26 of 174, the approved picture 19 of 153.
2997 final tier, the left limb: main, the commit. No difference I can see.
2997 final tier, below the spot: main, the commit. Here I see no fault; the commit is a little crisper.
2997 final tier, the right side with Io: main, the commit. The same flecks left of Io and above it.

Six times enlarged: the commit at one sample beside the commit at the final tier. Rows stay apart while the shutter smears along the way: the lookups of a sample are read at half a pixel, and where the picture moves 14 px only 4 or 5 of the 64 samples see one pixel of the path.
The same place at one sample (draft tier), twice enlarged: main, the commit. At one sample the commit is crisp and whole; the fault comes with the samples of the shutter.
The same place twice enlarged, final tier: main, the commit. The bricks are about 5 by 2 px.

A FAULT OF MY OWN COMMIT c6d64f97 (item 3 a), found before naming: 2997 master at the final tier, 64 samples, grain off, one to one, the upper right. Left main 262b9a68, right the commit. Where the wide level now draws, the moving ground breaks into small bricks and bright flecks. The commit is not named.
jupiter.hold frame 2820, draft tier
Test 2 with a weaker pull to coherent pieces: the same finish, the same stipple. A still of 2997 with this asset is queued.

Item 3 b, test 2 (the change the repaint made in the centre, carried by example to the ring, in code): top row the wrap beside the repaint in the centre, rows 2 to 4 three places of the ring, the wrap beside the wrap with the carried finish. Edges crisper, finest band of the ring 0.72 to 2.48 (centre 3.98). A fault I see: a fine stipple of dabs on flat cream ground; the repaint's curls do not form.
Test 1 close: the wide level as shipped, and two gains of the half scale forms. A small gain, no new forms.

Item 3 b, test 1 (the wrap's own forms at half scale laid into the ring): 2997 master at one to one, the left side. The ring gains 1.28 to 1.34 times in the finest band and stays visibly softer than the centre. I do not build this out.

Item 3 b, a map of 2997: dark green the repainted centre (mid level nested in the wide patch), light green its feather, orange the ring of the wide patch that holds only the enlarged wrap, red the ring blending with the wrap, purple the wrap alone. By ground: centre 0.561, feather 0.146, ring 0.163, ring blend 0.076, wrap alone 0.052. The ring's finest band holds about 0.27 of the centre's.

Smooth, pictures of the dive, frames 3010 + 1/2 to 3024 with the pair [1.12, 1.65]: RED, and it is main's known red, not new: pattern 0.84 at 3019 + 1/2 (main's own row of round 59 reads 0.84 there, first frame over the limit 3017 on both). The white patch is the ground at the horizon that leaves the frame.
The same pair, 3010 master at one to one, the upper right: main beside the commit.

Item 3 a, now the commit c6d64f97 on main 262b9a68 (not named yet, its tests run). 3010 master draft, one sample, three times enlarged, the limb at the upper right: main, the wide level on [1.12, 1.65], the difference times 4.
